declarations.type:
∀ {L L' : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayout},
  L'.order = L.order →
    ∀ (x : Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.FieldTuple 0),
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (S S' : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.FaceSegment),
          Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment S →
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment S' →
              S.radial = S'.radial →
                S.level = S'.level →
                  S.lo = S'.lo →
                    S.hi = S'.hi →
                      S.testCoef = S'.testCoef →
                        (S.radial = true → S.level ≠ 0) →
                          (S.radial = true → 0 ≤ min S.level S.other ∧ 0 ≤ min S'.level S'.other) →
                            ∀ (a : Fin 3) (d : ℕ),
                              S.moment false (L.velMode n x a) (L.gradModeOf n x a 0) (L.gradModeOf n x a 2) d =
                                  S'.moment false (L.velMode n x a) (L.gradModeOf n x a 0) (L.gradModeOf n x a 2) d ∧
                                ((if S.radial = true then
                                      S.moment true (L.gradModeOf n x a 0) (L.secondModeOf n x a 0 0)
                                        (L.secondModeOf n x a 0 2) d
                                    else
                                      S.moment true (L.gradModeOf n x a 2) (L.secondModeOf n x a 2 0)
                                        (L.secondModeOf n x a 2 2) d) =
                                    if S'.radial = true then
                                      S'.moment true (L.gradModeOf n x a 0) (L.secondModeOf n x a 0 0)
                                        (L.secondModeOf n x a 0 2) d
                                    else
                                      S'.moment true (L.gradModeOf n x a 2) (L.secondModeOf n x a 2 0)
                                        (L.secondModeOf n x a 2 2) d) ∧
                                  S.moment true (Breakdown.CertCell.headPressure L n x) (L.pressureGradMode n x 0)
                                      (L.pressureGradMode n x 2) d =
                                    S'.moment true (Breakdown.CertCell.headPressure L n x) (L.pressureGradMode n x 0)
                                      (L.pressureGradMode n x 2) d) →
        ∀ (S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.FaceSegment),
          Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment S →
            (S.radial = true → S.level ≠ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ min S.level S.other) →
              ∀ (n : ℤ) (a : Fin 3) (d : ℕ),
                S.moment false (L.velMode n x a) (L.gradModeOf n x a 0) (L.gradModeOf n x a 2) d =
                    Breakdown.CertCell.keyValue L' x
                      (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.SkeletonKey.velocity n S.radial S.level S.lo S.hi S.testCoef a
                        d) ∧
                  (if S.radial = true then
                        S.moment true (L.gradModeOf n x a 0) (L.secondModeOf n x a 0 0) (L.secondModeOf n x a 0 2) d
                      else
                        S.moment true (L.gradModeOf n x a 2) (L.secondModeOf n x a 2 0) (L.secondModeOf n x a 2 2) d) =
                      Breakdown.CertCell.keyValue L' x
                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.SkeletonKey.gradient n S.radial S.level S.lo S.hi S.testCoef
                          a d) ∧
                    S.moment true (Breakdown.CertCell.headPressure L n x) (L.pressureGradMode n x 0)
                        (L.pressureGradMode n x 2) d =
                      Breakdown.CertCell.keyValue L' x
                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.SkeletonKey.pressure n S.radial S.level S.lo S.hi S.testCoef
                          d)

declarations.type:
Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.PlaneDataFlipHolds →
  ∀ {Γ : Set Breakdown.Symmetry} {P : ℝ} {v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
    {G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
    {H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
    {g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space},
    Breakdown.IsPerturbation Γ P v G H g →
      (∃ γ ∈ Γ, (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), γ.1 y = Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) ∧ γ.2 = 0) →
        ∀ (ξ : ℤ × ℤ) {ρ₁ ρ₂ h : ℝ},
          0 < ρ₁ →
            ρ₁ < ρ₂ →
              0 < h →
                ∀ {φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ} {K : NNReal},
                  LipschitzWith K φ →
                    (∀ (z : ℝ), φ (ρ₁, z) = 0 ∧ φ (ρ₂, z) = 0) →
                      (∀ (r : ℝ), φ (r, h) = 0) →

                          ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.patch ρ₁ ρ₂ h,
                            (fderiv ℝ φ p) (1, 0) *
                                  (↑p.1 *
                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.planeVel (Breakdown.CertCell.flipLabel ξ) v 0 p.1 p.2) +
                                (fderiv ℝ φ p) (0, 1) *
                                  (↑p.1 *
                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.planeVel (Breakdown.CertCell.flipLabel ξ) v 2 p.1 p.2) +
                              φ p *

  {L : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayout},

      ∀ {v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space} {G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
        {H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
        (Pg : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsPeriodicSecondOrder v G H →
          ∀ {m : ℕ},
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout c0 K S0 B L →
              L.order = m →
                ∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                  L.modes = {ι.1} →
                    ∀ (freq : ℝ) (φ : Fin 3 → Breakdown.CertCell.CellPoly) (hw : Fin 3 → ℝ × ℝ → ℂ),
                      (∀ (a : Fin 3), Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsBivariatePoly L.degCoef L.degCoef (hw a)) →
                        (∀ (a : Fin 3) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                            ↑p.1 * Breakdown.CertCell.CellPoly.eval K (φ a) p = ↑(K.lineWeight p.1) * hw a p) →

  {H : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space},
  Breakdown.CertCell.LocalField.IsLocalSecondOrderField v G H →
    ∀ (n : ℤ) {c o lo hi : ℝ},
      0 < c →
        0 ≤ o →
          c ≠ o →
            lo < hi →
              0 ≤ lo →
                ∀ {t : ℝ → ℝ},
                  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) t →
                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.radialStripMoment c o lo hi
                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.gradMode m n G 0 0)
                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeThird m n H 0 0 0) t =
                      -↑(1 / c) *
                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.radialStripMoment c o lo hi
                                  (fun p => Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec m n v p.1 p.2 0)
                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.gradMode m n G 0 0) t +
                                ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.azimuth m n) * Complex.I *
                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.radialStripMoment c o lo hi
                                    (fun p => Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec m n v p.1 p.2 1)
                                    (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.gradMode m n G 1 0) t) -

                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.gradMode m n G 2 0)
                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.gradMode m n G 2 2)
                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeThird m n H 2 0 2) +
                          ↑(t lo) *

                              (fun p => Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec m n v p.1 p.2 2)
                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.gradMode m n G 2 0)
                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.gradMode m n G 2 2)
                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeThird m n H 2 0 2) +
                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.radialStripMoment c o lo hi

declarations.type:
∀ {j : ℕ} (x : Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.FieldTuple j),
  Breakdown.CertCell.LocalField.IsLocalSecondOrderField x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2.1 →

      ∀ (L : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayout),
        (∀ (n : ℤ) (S S' : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.FaceSegment),
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment S →
              Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment S' →

                  S.level = S'.level →
                    S.lo = S'.lo →
                      S.hi = S'.hi →
                        S.testCoef = S'.testCoef →
                          (S.radial = true → S.level ≠ 0) →
                            (S.radial = true → 0 ≤ min S.level S.other ∧ 0 ≤ min S'.level S'.other) →
                              ∀ (a : Fin 3) (d : ℕ),
                                S.moment false (L.velMode n x a) (L.gradModeOf n x a 0) (L.gradModeOf n x a 2) d =
                                    S'.moment false (L.velMode n x a) (L.gradModeOf n x a 0) (L.gradModeOf n x a 2) d ∧
                                  ((if S.radial = true then
                                        S.moment true (L.gradModeOf n x a 0) (L.secondModeOf n x a 0 0)
                                          (L.secondModeOf n x a 0 2) d
                                      else
                                        S.moment true (L.gradModeOf n x a 2) (L.secondModeOf n x a 2 0)
                                          (L.secondModeOf n x a 2 2) d) =
                                      if S'.radial = true then
                                        S'.moment true (L.gradModeOf n x a 0) (L.secondModeOf n x a 0 0)
                                          (L.secondModeOf n x a 0 2) d
                                      else
                                        S'.moment true (L.gradModeOf n x a 2) (L.secondModeOf n x a 2 0)
                                          (L.secondModeOf n x a 2 2) d) ∧
                                    S.moment true (Breakdown.CertCell.headPressure L n x) (L.pressureGradMode n x 0)
                                        (L.pressureGradMode n x 2) d =
                                      S'.moment true (Breakdown.CertCell.headPressure L n x) (L.pressureGradMode n x 0)
                                        (L.pressureGradMode n x 2) d) ∧
          (∀ (n : ℤ) (cr cz orr oz orr' oz' : ℝ),
              cr ≠ 0 →
                orr ≠ cr →
                  oz ≠ cz →
                    orr' ≠ cr →
                      oz' ≠ cz →
                        0 ≤ min cr orr →
                          0 ≤ min cr orr' →
                            ∀ (a : Fin 3),
                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.cornerMoment cr orr cz oz (L.velMode n x a)
                                  (L.gradModeOf n x a 0) (L.gradModeOf n x a 2) (L.secondModeOf n x a 0 2) =
                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.cornerMoment cr orr' cz oz' (L.velMode n x a)
                                  (L.gradModeOf n x a 0) (L.gradModeOf n x a 2) (L.secondModeOf n x a 0 2)) ∧
            ∀ (cr cz oz oz' : ℝ),
              0 < cr →
                oz ≠ cz →
                  oz' ≠ cz →
                    (Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.heightStripMoment cz oz 0 cr (fun r => r) (L.velMode 0 x 2)
                        (L.gradModeOf 0 x 2 2) fun x => 1) =
                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.heightStripMoment cz oz' 0 cr (fun r => r) (L.velMode 0 x 2)
                        (L.gradModeOf 0 x 2 2) fun x => 1

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.SegmentLine.lineForm_byParts
declarations.type:
∀ {π : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} {s : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} {A B : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ},
  Continuous π →
    IsCompact s →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn A s MeasureTheory.volume →
        ∀ {α β : ℝ},
          α < β →
            ∀ (Q : Prop),
              (∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ),
                  Continuous g →
                    (Q ∨ ∃ g₀, Continuous g₀ ∧ ∀ (u : ℝ), g u = (u - α) * g₀ u) →
                      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun p => B p * ↑(g (π p))) s MeasureTheory.volume) →
                (∀ (h : ℝ → ℝ),
                    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
                      h α = 0 →
                        h β = 0 →
                          (Q ∨ ∃ h₀, Continuous h₀ ∧ ∀ (u : ℝ), h u = (u - α) * h₀ u) →
                            Breakdown.CertCell.SegmentLine.lineForm π s A B (deriv h) h = 0) →
                  ∀ {t : ℝ → ℝ},
                    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) t →
                      (Q ∨ ∃ t₀, Continuous t₀ ∧ ∀ (u : ℝ), t u = (u - α) * t₀ u) →
                        Breakdown.CertCell.SegmentLine.lineForm π s A B (deriv t) t =
                          (↑(t β) *
                              Breakdown.CertCell.SegmentLine.lineForm π s A B (fun x => 1 / (β - α)) fun u =>
                                (u - α) / (β - α)) +
                            ↑(t α) *
                              Breakdown.CertCell.SegmentLine.lineForm π s A B (fun x => 1 / (α - β)) fun u =>
                                (u - β) / (α - β)

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.KeyFlip.Internal.lift_gen
declarations.type:
∀ {v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space} {G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space},
  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.HarmonicLiftStatement →
    ∀ (m : ℕ),
      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsPeriodicSecondOrder v G H →
        ∀ {ν n : ℤ},
          Even (n + ν) →
            Breakdown.CertCell.LocalField.IsLocalSecondOrderField (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.harmonicCos ν v)
                (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.harmonicCos ν G) (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.harmonicCos ν H) ∧
              Breakdown.CertCell.LocalField.IsLocalSecondOrderField (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.harmonicSin ν v)
                  (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.harmonicSin ν G) (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.harmonicSin ν H) ∧
                ∀ᵐ (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                  0 < p.1 →
                    (∀ (a : Fin 3),
                        Breakdown.CertCell.PlaneFlipFacts.planeVelocity
                            (Breakdown.CertCell.labelHarmonic m (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.harmonicMode ν n)) v a
                            p =
                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec m n (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.harmonicCos ν v)
                              p.1 p.2 a +
                            Complex.I *
                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec m n
                                (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.harmonicSin ν v) p.1 p.2 a) ∧
                      (∀ (a b : Fin 3),
                          Breakdown.CertCell.PlaneFlipFacts.planeGrad
                              (Breakdown.CertCell.labelHarmonic m (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.harmonicMode ν n)) G
                              a b p =
                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.gradMode m n
                                (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.harmonicCos ν G) a b p +
                              Complex.I *
                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.gradMode m n
                                  (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.harmonicSin ν G) a b p) ∧
                        ∀ (a b c : Fin 3),
                          Breakdown.CertCell.PlaneFlipFacts.planeSlope
                              (Breakdown.CertCell.labelHarmonic m (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.harmonicMode ν n)) H
                              a b c p =
                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeThird m n
                                (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.harmonicCos ν H) a b c p +
                              Complex.I *
                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeThird m n
                                  (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.harmonicSin ν H) a b c p

declarations.type:
∀ {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox},
  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBox K →
    ∀ {c o : ℝ},
      min c o = K.r₁ →
        max c o = K.r₂ →
          c ≠ o →
            (c ≠ 0 → o = 0 ∨ 0 < K.r₁) →
              ∀ {Fc Fs dFc dFs P dP : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ} {C0 : ℂ},
                MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn Fc K.rect MeasureTheory.volume →
                  MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn Fs K.rect MeasureTheory.volume →
                    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn P K.rect MeasureTheory.volume →
                      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun p => ↑p.1 * dFc p) K.rect MeasureTheory.volume →
                        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun p => ↑p.1 * dFs p) K.rect MeasureTheory.volume →
                          MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun p => ↑p.1 * dP p) K.rect MeasureTheory.volume →
                            (∀ᵐ (p : ℝ × ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict K.rect, Fc p + Complex.I * Fs p = P p - C0) →
                              (∀ᵐ (p : ℝ × ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict K.rect, dFc p + Complex.I * dFs p = dP p) →
                                ∀ {w : ℝ → ℂ},
                                  Continuous w →
                                    (↑c *
                                          ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in K.rect,
                                            Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.RowLow.Internal.radialIntegrand c o Fc dFc
                                                p *
                                              w p.2) +
                                        Complex.I *
                                          (↑c *
                                            ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in K.rect,
                                              Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.RowLow.Internal.radialIntegrand c o Fs dFs
                                                  p *
                                                w p.2) =
                                      (Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.edgeSign c o *
                                          ∫ (z : ℝ) in Set.Icc K.z₁ K.z₂,
                                            ↑c * Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.radialStripTrace c o P dP z * w z) -
                                        C0 * Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.edgeSign c o *
                                          (↑c * ∫ (z : ℝ) in Set.Icc K.z₁ K.z₂, w z)
